authority.rule: This contract classifies support for a declared use. It does not convert weights into truth probabilities.

principles: TOKEN_VAZIO is a valid epistemic record and never coerces to zero, false, null, success or failure.
A valid token is valid only for its declared domain, use and time window.
Weights measure linked support dimensions; they are not learned truth scores.
Missing required support is non-compensatory: strong dimensions cannot average away TOKEN_VAZIO.
Tokenization must preserve source boundaries, negation, modality, conditions, exceptions, numbers and units.

dimensions.name: provenance
dimensions.meaning: source, author, revision, locator and custody

dimensions.name: semantic_fidelity
dimensions.meaning: meaning, negation, modality, conditions and exceptions preserved

dimensions.name: formal_consistency
dimensions.meaning: logic, dimensions, derivation and baseline consistency

dimensions.name: reproducibility
dimensions.meaning: command, versions, seed, environment, tests and artifact identity

dimensions.name: governance
dimensions.meaning: privacy, consent, authority, claim gate and rollback

aggregation.quality_formula: minimum numeric weight across required dimensions
